justification: In core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/datamatrix/encoder/MinimalEncoder.java, Result is a private static nested helper with one field (byte[] bytes) and one constructor taking a single Edge. It is instantiated only once in MinimalEncoder.encodeMinimally(...) at the return site (`new Result(edges[inputLength][minimalJ])`). A repository-wide rg found no other references to MinimalEncoder.Result outside that file; the tests in core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/datamatrix/encoder/HighLevelEncodeTestCase.java exercise MinimalEncoder.encodeHighLevel(...), not Result. This shows very low fan-in and fan-out, so the class is not a dependency hub.
